name: FlashInfer: Efficient and Customizable Attention Engine for LLM Inference Serving (MLSys 2025)
notes: FlashInfer paper. Key results: 29-69% inter-token-latency reduction vs compiler backends, 28-30% latency reduction for long-context inference, 13-17% speedup for LLM serving with parallel generation. Introduces load-balanced scheduling compatible with CUDA Graphs. The arXiv abstract was fetched and verified.
